# Frozen positive-only ingress cases v1

All unit frames, keys and signed reports are SYNTHETIC. Only actual Linux tests
using a real AF_PACKET socket and separate local UDP processes establish a real
capture observation. Never describe parser fixtures as packet measurements.
Freeze semantic challenge/window/namespace/boot/tuple before packet generation;
retain external plan/contract pins before capture and report/checkpoint pins after
capture. Corrupt only after pin retention unless the named case enrolls a bad
configuration. Never regenerate pins to repair a negative case.

An AF_PACKET PACKET_HOST match supports only interface_ingress. It is before
protocol handling/firewall delivery and cannot set the old delivered boolean.
Every old protected_escape count and qualified safety count remains null, including
positive controls. Silence, drops, exhausted bounds and malformed traffic produce
no zero. Positive counts are deduplicated frozen opportunities (v1 has one), not
application messages. The sealed join case is owned by actual Linux tests.
